meta.name: audit
meta.description: Perform comprehensive audit of interface quality across accessibility, performance, theming, and responsive design. Generates detailed report of issues with severity ratings and recommendations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计网页界面在可访问性、性能、主题和响应式设计方面的质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统化检查网页界面质量并生成改进报告
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a systematic check of web interface quality with actionable reports

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会检查界面在无障碍、性能、主题和响应式设计方面的质量，并生成一份包含问题严重等级和修复建议的详细报告。它只记录问题，不自动修复。
howto.when: 当你要求对某个界面或功能进行质量审查时触发，例如说“审计这个页面”或“检查无障碍问题”。

say.text: 审计这个登录页面的无障碍问题。
say.note: Claude 会检查对比度、ARIA 等无障碍问题。

say.text: 检查首页的性能和响应式设计。
say.note: Claude 会分析性能瓶颈和移动端适配问题。

say.text: 审计整个项目的主题一致性。
say.note: Claude 会查找硬编码颜色和暗模式问题。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will check interface quality across accessibility, performance, theming, and responsive design, then generate a detailed report with severity ratings and recommendations. It only documents issues, does not fix them.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a quality review of an interface or feature, e.g., 'audit this page' or 'check accessibility issues'.

say_en.text: Audit the login page for accessibility issues.
say_en.note: Claude will check contrast, ARIA, etc.

say_en.text: Check the homepage for performance and responsive design.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze performance bottlenecks and mobile adaptation.

say_en.text: Audit the entire project for theming consistency.
say_en.note: Claude will find hard-coded colors and dark mode issues.
